text:
The most recent Republican to win the New York gubernatorial election was **George Pataki in 1994** (he took office in 1995). When Pataki first ran for governor, he appeared on the ballot under three party lines:

| Party line | Notes |
|------------|-------|
| **Republican** | The main Republican line. |
| **Conservative** | New York’s Conservative Party endorsed Pataki. |
| **Tax Cut Now** | A third ballot line created by the Tax Cut Now Party, which also endorsed him in that election. |

These three lines are shown in the official voter‑records for the 1994 contest:

- **Source**: New York State Board of Elections, *1994 New York gubernatorial election results* (contest 4905) [link](https://results.elections.ny.gov/contest/4905).
